name: Save Folder
author: tago
description: Adds "Open save folder" and "Copy executable path" to a game's Manage menu.
details: Finds where a game keeps its saves by its Steam App ID, in the same places the achievement tracker looks: GSE Saves, Goldberg, CODEX, RUNE, OnlineFix, EMPRESS and others. Handy for backing up saves by hand or moving them between PCs.
affects: Adds two items to the Manage menu on a game's page
